repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbUb7TcZK1XUAddUmQ

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `66f76e14001f20f923b8c53d5716182ba2ba87c7`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json, skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md, skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: no

Basis: PR #35312 for cards #34798 and #35070, with the p3 rider #34277. Read: the three card bodies and their threads (claim 6999128364 and dev report 6999544535 on #34798), the PR body and file list (a draft, no comments or reviews yet), the net diff from merge-base `bc75bcdbc` to the head (5 files, 82 lines added, 25 removed), the 49 check-runs on the head, ruling record 6513306068, and the cited code in the head tree (read, not reviewed). `main` is at `de8d54975`; since the merge-base it has changed none of the five paths, no file under `skills/`, and none of the cited code (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`, `packages/spec/src/data/`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/`). Nothing was built, run or re-run: byte counts are read off git blobs, and the eval token sources were counted by text search over the two bundles as the base and head trees hold them. The changeset is a prose face: it is noted for the seat's sentence check, not reviewed here.

The security line reads `no` because no changed hunk teaches permission, sharing, credential, token, authentication or other security behaviour. The hunks teach seed import modes, the `locale` / `fallback` / `dependsOn` keys, load order and `externalId` choice. Three near misses were read and are not security teaching: the eval file's name carries the word "security" but only its seed cases (4, 30, 31) change; case 4's line keeps its unchanged `owner_id: cel` value and changes only the load-order phrase; the "token" in the ratchet hunks is the pricing unit. The lookup-by-id note ("e.g. a system user") is reference resolution and its meaning is unchanged.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept set and public surface: no change. The diff is two skill files, one eval fixture, two rows of the token ratchet and one changeset. No package source, schema or export moves; the keys and refusals it teaches landed earlier (`insert` / `replace` retirement f7960893c, `dependsOn` d10f652f1, `fallback` via #35065) and are in the head tree.

Every new or reworded sentence, against the head tree (`seed.zod.ts` is `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`, `seed-loader.ts` is `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`):

1. `seeds.md:48`, `externalId` is the "Stable business key (or field list) every mode matches on". Holds. The key is a string or a non-empty list (`seed.zod.ts:210-213`); the three live modes are `update`, `upsert`, `ignore` (`seed.zod.ts:58-62`) and "Every mode matches on `externalId`" (`seed.zod.ts:265-266`). A list is matched part by part, on resolved ids for reference fields (`seed-loader.ts:5351-5362`).
2. `seeds.md:52`, `locale`: default "every locale", "BCP-47 tags it loads for; a locale no set of the object names gets none". Holds. Optional, no default, omitted means unrestricted (`seed.zod.ts:368-369`, `seed-loader.ts:357-362`); a set scoped to other locales is dropped (`seed-loader.ts:4849-4879`); "gets none ... unless one of them is marked" is the schema's own sentence (`seed.zod.ts:364-366`).
3. `seeds.md:53`, `fallback`: "`true` on ONE `locale` set per object: also loads for a locale no set names". Holds. The only value is `true` (`seed.zod.ts:414`); it needs `locale` or the parse refuses (`seed.zod.ts:502-515`); it is kept when no locale-scoped set of its object lists the resolved locale (`seed-loader.ts:395-401`, `:4858`); two different marked sets of one object leave none used as the fallback (`seed-loader.ts:5514-5541`, `:1357-1361`).
4. `seeds.md:54`, `dependsOn`: "Objects it loads after when no lookup links them". Holds (`seed.zod.ts:450-456`; edges join the lookup graph at `seed-loader.ts:1570-1574`).
5. `seeds.md:67`, "`insert` / `replace` are refused (every replay re-inserted each record)". Holds. Both values parse to a refusal whose text gives that reason (`seed.zod.ts:48-55`, `:64`, `:76`); a stored dataset carrying one is refused alone (`seed-loader.ts:1638-1670`) and `loadDataset` refuses the mode again before any write (`seed-loader.ts:1695-1716`).
6. `seeds.md:67-69`, the conversion: default mode with a composite `externalId` (`['team', 'project']`), or `'id'` when the records carry their own ids. Holds, and it is the refusal's own prescription, `SEED_MODE_RETIRED_FIX` (`seed.zod.ts:29-33`), same example included. The single-field arm of that text is the page's existing `externalId` section.
7. `seeds.md:77-79`, `applyOn: 'create'`, reworded only. Holds (`seed.zod.ts:86-115`).
8. `seeds.md:95-96`, "Never use `id` for generated UUIDs". Holds, and the narrowing is needed: without it the page would forbid the `'id'` arm it teaches at `:69`. The schema's own note is "`id` is rarely used for portable seed data" (`seed.zod.ts:197-198`).
9. `seeds.md:107-110`, "lookups order the load: a child loads after its parent however the array lists them (array order only breaks ties)". Holds. A `lookup`, `master_detail` or `user` field that points at another object of the load adds an edge (`seed-loader.ts:1519`, `:1546-1552`); the order is a Kahn sort whose start queue is in dataset order (`seed-loader.ts:4403-4447`); the datasets are then sorted by it (`seed-loader.ts:1395`, `:4908-4915`). The schema says it in the same words (`seed.zod.ts:434-437`). So the three "parents first" spots of the base page (`:40`, `:105-106`, `:162`) ordered nothing, as #34277 says.
10. `seeds.md:128-129`, a `beforeInsert` hook reading a seeded object no lookup links to needs `dependsOn` with object names. Holds (`seed.zod.ts:428-432`, `:450`).
11. `seeds.md:129-131`, the three refusals and "nothing is written". Holds, each arm: own object (`seed-loader.ts:4518-4527`, and `defineSeed` at `seed.zod.ts:746-755`); a name no dataset of the load seeds, with the scoped-out case told apart (`seed-loader.ts:4529-4541`); an edge that closes a cycle (`seed-loader.ts:4561-4610`). The load returns before pass 1 with no dataset result (`seed-loader.ts:1373-1386`, `:4644-4663`; pass 1 starts at `:1454`), and the steps before that return only read: the organization lookup (`seed-loader.ts:1333-1337`, `:3128`), the landed-key ledger opening (`:1365`, `:5147-5177`) and the object definitions for the graph (`:1511`).
12. `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:377-379`, the mode list is `ignore` default, `upsert`, `update`. Holds (`seed.zod.ts:58-62`, `:259`). Its link target, the `### Import modes` heading, is still at `seeds.md:59`.

Cuts, and where each instruction still lives in the same file:

- Best-practice row "Prefer natural keys": `seeds.md:95-103`.
- Best-practice row "Leave `mode` unset; `upsert` only for reference data": the mode table's default marker and "Use for" column (`seeds.md:63-64`) and the field row (`:49`).
- Best-practice row "Scope demo data with `env`": the quick start (`seeds.md:31-34`) and the field row (`:51`).
- "An `upsert` replay re-asserts every column": `seeds.md:64`.
- "no other mode updates a matched row": `seeds.md:63` (and `seed.zod.ts:96-97` agrees).
- "Natural keys remain the portable default": `seeds.md:107-108`.
- Not restatement but teaching the code refuses or never honoured, so nothing is owed for them: the `insert` and `replace` rows, the `replace` best-practice row, and the three array-order spots.

No instruction is lost.

Eval token sources. The runner installs only the case's own bundle, without `evals/` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/arms.ts:86-100`). Every `must_contain` string of `skills/objectstack-data/evals/*.json` (152 distinct) and `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/*.json` (66 distinct) was counted in its own bundle's non-eval files at the merge-base and at the head. No string that had a source at the base is without one at the head. The strings with no literal source at the head (20 in the data bundle, 6 in the platform bundle) had none at the base either; they are composed answers, not quotations. Four strings lose occurrences in `seeds.md` and keep a source: `upsert` (5 to 3, plus `SKILL.md`), `env:` (2 to 1, the quick start at `:34`), `customer` (3 to 2), and `caller` (2 to 0 in `seeds.md`; its case 24 is about hooks and reads `references/data-hooks.md` and `rules/security.md`). The platform bundle's counts are unchanged for all 66. The defect that failed the sibling PR is not present here.

Rest of the published catalog. A search of `skills/` for the retired modes, "parents first" and its variants, and seed-mode wording finds nothing that contradicts the new text: the only remaining mention of the retired modes is the refusal sentence (`seeds.md:67`) and case 30. Other `insert` hits are row-level security operations, validation events and the import door's `writeMode`, which are different surfaces. `ui/skills/` holds no file in this tree. Neither skill file points into `content/docs`; `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx` (its retirement, `fallback` and `dependsOn` sections) agrees with the page.

The dev's readings reproduce. Premise A1 to A4 on `bc75bcdbc`: `seeds.md:62`, `:64`, `:163`; no `locale` or `fallback` row at `:45-52`; `:40`, `:105-106`, `:162`; platform `SKILL.md:377-378`. Done-when: the card's grep for a quoted `mode: 'insert'` or `'replace'` finds nothing under `skills/` on the head and found nothing on the merge-base either, so by itself it shows nothing; the wider search for the two modes as code spans in the two files gives 4 lines on the merge-base and 1 on the head, the refusal sentence. The array-order search gives 4 lines on the merge-base and none on the head.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`: all three correct, and both declaration lines are line-initial in the PR body and the changeset body. The page teaches keys and refusals that already shipped; nothing a metadata author can write is added, refused or given a new meaning by this diff, and no code moves, so the kind is `none` and `none` takes `patch`. It is not a `(narrowing)`: skill prose narrows no accepted set. With the kind `none`, no `Skills-docs:` line is owed. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report 6999544535: `open_questions` none, `security_findings` none. This record agrees.

Deviations and notes, each answered:

- Eval cases 30 and 31 placed after case 4, not appended. Accepted. The file parses, its 27 ids are distinct, and the two open siblings that edit it add other ids (#34964: 25, 26; #35309: 28, 29). Position carries no meaning: a case is keyed by bundle, file and id (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/cases.ts:88`).
- Case 4's `expected_output` corrected. Accepted, and correct against item 9 above. That field is neither sent nor graded and is outside the case hash (`cases.ts:99`), so recorded rounds still match the case.
- The platform row was lowered, not only annotated. Accepted: lowering is always legitimate (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:153`), and the claim's "row notes only" fence is about the gate's logic, which the diff does not touch.
- Four build-reading gates not measured locally. Answered by CI: all 49 check-runs on the head are complete, 31 success, 18 skipped, none failed, none pending. `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Build Core`, `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are among the green ones.
- Out-of-scope note, the card's done-when grep was already empty on `main`. Confirmed, see ①. The wider search is the reading that shows the card met. Whether to reword the card's done-when is the seat's.

One note from this read, outside the diff and not a finding on this PR: `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx:835` still captions `index.ts` as exporting the array "in dependency order", beside the same page's own statement that array order only breaks ties. Whether that is a docs card is the seat's filing-gate call.

SQL push-down check: the diff has no query code, so no id materialisation and no in-app join.

The PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no off-relay author note is owed.

Both ratchet rows are pinned at zero headroom. A PR that lands first on `seeds.md` or on the platform `SKILL.md` makes these rows stale; neither open sibling touches those two files.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md`: the change holds against the loader and the schema (① items 1 to 11) and against each card's scenario. #34798: an agent following the page no longer writes a dataset the parse refuses, and the sentence that replaces the two rows carries the refusal's own fix, so the page and the error an author meets say the same thing. #35070: both keys are in the field table in the schema's terms. #34277: the page no longer gives advice the loader never honoured, and it teaches the one case where the author must declare order. The reworded "Never use `id`" removes a contradiction the conversion would otherwise have created.

`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`: one sentence, now the live mode set, with a working link.

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`: both new prompts exercise what the page teaches, both expected outputs are right against the code (case 30: `seed.zod.ts:29-33`, `seed-loader.ts:5351-5362`; case 31: `seed.zod.ts:371-423`, `:502-515`, `seed-loader.ts:4858`), and every graded string can be produced from the installed bundle. The mechanical assertions are looser than the teaching; see N2 and N3.

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (the gate that enforces both files' ceilings): the rows agree with the ruling they claim. Ruling record 6513306068 (on #27847, letter B, part 2) and the ratchet header (`:156-170`) put three conditions on a raise and leave the first two to this record:

- The diff shows deletion of restatement in the same file: yes, six deletions in `seeds.md` of 83, 87, 72, 78, 37 and 57 bytes, 414 in all, each with a remaining home listed in ①.
- The PR body quotes the ruling: yes, the 2026-10-27 words 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 and record 6513306068, letter B. The row comment (`:1782-1795`) repeats them.
- The row moves by the measured remainder, pinned at the measurement: yes. Base blob 6984 bytes, 1746 tokens, headroom 0. After the six cuts 6570. Head blob 7036, so the teaching nets plus 466, and ceil(7036 / 4) is 1759, the row at `:1796`. Plus 13, every figure in the row comment matches.

The platform row needs no ruling: head blob 24611 bytes, minus the 20-byte stamp line is 24591 priced, ceil(24591 / 4) is 6148 (`:847`); the base was 24669, 24649 priced, 6163. Down 15, as the comment (`:843-846`) and the changeset say. The eval file is measured, not priced (letter B, part 1): 23751 to 25624 bytes, 5938 to 6406, which with plus 13 and minus 15 gives the PR body's bundle delta of plus 466.

The 10402 principle (no growth for a small feature) is not engaged: 13 tokens carry three cards, and two of them correct teaching that was false against the loader.

Findings. No must-fix. No should-fix. Five nits, none of which touches correctness or the contract; all are accepted as they stand on this head.

- N1 (nit). `seeds.md:131`, "or a cycle". The refusal is for a `dependsOn` name that closes a cycle (`seed-loader.ts:4561-4610`); a cycle of lookup fields alone still loads in passes (`seed-loader.ts:4451-4469`, `seed.zod.ts:446-447`). The sentence's subject is "Naming", inside the `dependsOn` paragraph, so it reads correctly; "or one closing a cycle" would remove the other reading at about 3 tokens, against a row with no headroom.
- N2 (nit). Case 30's assertions do not pin the composite shape: an answer with a single-field `externalId` passes. `externalId: [` as a third `must_contain` string would pin it. Its two `must_not_contain` strings are the quoted spellings, so an answer that quotes a retired mode in order to warn against it fails; that is the file's existing convention (case 4 forbids `new Date(` the same way).
- N3 (nit). Case 31's two strings discriminate little: `locale` is in the prompt and `fallback` is the ordinary English word for the scenario, so the no-skill arm can pass with an invented key. `fallback: true` would pin the taught spelling. The card asked for a case that exercises `fallback`, which this is.
- N4 (nit). The `locale` row does not carry two facts an author can trip on: tags match exactly apart from case, so `['zh']` does not match `zh-CN` (`seed.zod.ts:327-329`, `seed-loader.ts:345-362`), and a load that carries no locale loads every set (`seed.zod.ts:334-337`). "Gets none" is also short for none of the object's locale-scoped rows: an unscoped set of the same object still loads. The page points at the Zod file, which states all three, and #35070 asked for the keys to be named.
- N5 (nit). "Array order only breaks ties" follows the schema's wording. Inside a cycle of lookup fields the array order also decides which side is written first (`seed-loader.ts:4451-4469`). The base page said nothing about cycles, so nothing regresses.

A follow-up for N2 and N3 (two strings in the eval file, unpriced) is the seat's filing-gate call.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:数据技能的 seeds 参考删掉已退役的种子模式，写明 `Seed.locale` / `fallback` / `dependsOn`,不再教「数组顺序就是加载顺序」;平台技能同步一句；评测加两例；棘轮 seeds 行 1746 → 1759,平台行 6163 → 6148。
- 为什么改:技能教的种子写法与 `seed.zod.ts` / `seed-loader.ts` 不符(#34798、#35070,随行 p3 #34277 同文件)。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字、评测、changeset 与棘轮数字；无代码。回滚 = revert。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` 改写段。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 seeds 行 `1759`、平台行 `6148`,末行 ✓。
- 需要你做的:审阅并合并或批准(Tier H)。合同审查 PASS 7000000564,Head-sha `66f76e14001f20f923b8c53d5716182ba2ba87c7`。席位意见:12 处新句与代码一致，删减不丢指令，评测可答，可合。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#5 · head `66f76e14001f20f923b8c53d5716182ba2ba87c7` · 2026-11-19T04:48Z

- **形态:** 5 files, +82/−25; governed `skills/**` plus the ratchet script → Tier H (the script, and a catalog path naming security, keep it off the low-risk skills arm). `Fixes #34798`, `Fixes #35070`, `Fixes #34277` (p3 riding the same file, ≤5 cards). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, changeset `@objectstack/skills` patch. Claim 6999128364.
- **合同审查:** PASS 7000000564 at this head, first round, no must-fix, no should-fix. All 12 new or reworded sentences hold against `seed.zod.ts` and `seed-loader.ts`; the six cuts lose no instruction and no eval `must_contain` source; ratchet 7036 bytes → 1759 under ruling 6513306068 letter B (three conditions met); platform 24591 priced → 6148. `Security-touching: no`.
- **门禁:** check-runs on head at handoff: 31 success, 18 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. Merge waits for approval.
- **接受的偏差:** nits N1–N5 need no push (N2/N3 eval discrimination, N4/N5 locale exact-match and lookup-cycle order not carried).
- **范围外去向:** `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx:835` still says "in dependency order"; carried to the docs lane as a follow-up, not this PR.
- **落地条款:** Tier H. K = 5 first-parent commits on `main` since merge base `bc75bcdb` (< 15). This stroke: `pm:awaiting-merge` + reviewers os-zhuang, hotlong. After approval the seat lands; on MERGED close-out on #34798, #35070, #34277.
